messages:
Maya: good morning team! woke up to the dashboard — we hit 131M ARR overnight. thank you all. felt like a fireworks gif in my inbox. 

Priya: WHAT??!!! this calls for sunrise donuts. who :doughnut: :confetti_ball:

Chen: congrats!! huge props to the SDK and infra folks for the quick turnaround. zero rollback, huge wow. :raised_hands:

Devon: i will DJ. playlist suggestions? chillcongrats or morning pump? :headphones:

Luis: donut poll: plain glazed, maple bacon, or matcha? react with :doughnut:, :bacon:, :leafy_green:.  poll ends in 20m.

Ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Sunrise Donuts + Drumroll" at 8:30am in kitchen. Capacity: 30. (automated)

Maya: also — tiny swag drop. enamel pins and stickers. can anyone help assemble swag bags at 8:00? need 3 people.

Priya: i'll do it. bringing extra pins for remote folks to mail. postal sign-up: drop your address in #people-ops.

Chen: massive shoutout to the benchmarks team or catching the throughput regression two days ago. saved the launch. :star2:

Devon: Meme corner: "me reviewing logs at 3am -> 131M ARR notification" [imgur.com/xyz] :joy:

Luis: poll tally so far: :doughnut: 6, :bacon: 2, :leafy_green: 4. glazed wins if this holds.

Maya: remote teammates — if you can't make it, we'll mail a pin. also planning a short toast (1min) to call out winners and folks who kept latency under budget.

Chen: tiny logistics note or anyone driving in or parking: leave the spots near loading dock free for vendor drop at 8:05.

Priya: RSVP: Maya, Priya, Chen, Devon, Luis. slot for 2 more volunteers to pack swag: please DM me.

Maya: thanks team. quick one-line shoutouts in thread pls — i'll compile into a slide for the all-hands. i'll start: "big love to infra and SDK for silent hero work." :heart:

Devon: "ops late-night heroes and the benchmarking duo."

Chen: "docs sprint that saved the rollout."

Luis: "vendor whisperer who negotiated extra vegan donuts." :seedling:

Maya: perfect. see you (and the donuts) at 8:30. drumroll optional but encouraged. :drum_with_drumsticks:
